title: Incremental Multi-Agent Build Graph Service
description: Heavily optimize the build system so developing is incredibly fast for many agents and workspaces editing the monorepo simultaneously on a 16 GB RAM / 200 GB disk host, with bounded resources (no cache/RAM/swap exhaustion or crashes over long sessions). Implement the target design from the norm ticket's 🔍️audits/fleet-1108-build-graph-design-review.md: one per-host incremental graph service shared by all agents/workspaces, fine-grained content-addressed dependency DAG with early cutoff, watcher-driven invalidation, MVCC pinned revisions, demand-driven target-scoped planning, hard per-job memory limits, size-capped CAS with LRU GC, fair global scheduling. Coordinate a fleet of parallel agents.
